{{Top|leg}}
A '''Hardsuit''' was a type of archaic [[Environment suit/Legends|space suit]] that allowed a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to leave their [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]]. Several were kept aboard the [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|YT-2400 light freighter]] [[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|''Junker'']] and in about [[41 ABY]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]] used a hardsuit to exit the ''Junker'', as part of an arrangement that he made with the [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] agent [[Nyss Nenn]] to hand himself over in return for the release of Korr's friend [[Khedryn Faal]], who had been captured by Nenn.
